d:
Yuvanshankar Raja croons for ‘Kadhal Aasai’ from Anjaan featuring Suriya & Samantha. A beautiful love ballad written by Kabilan, the song is all about anyone and everyone falling in love. Raju Bhai being one of the biggest dons in Mumbai falls for the bubbly Jeeva and her charm. Hear this song and find yourself smiling away in love
Song Name - Kadhal Aasai
Movie - Anjaan
Singer - Yuvanshankar Raja & Sooraj Santhosh
Music - Yuvanshankar Raja
Videos - Kabilan
Director - N. Linguswamy
Starring - Suriya, Samantha
